title: Mysterious New B94 Nuclear Bomb Designation Emerges, First In Decades
summary: A mysterious new nuclear bomb designation, B94, has emerged, marking the first such designation in decades. Speculation suggests the B94 could be the Nuclear Deterrent System-Air-delivered bunker buster, which is the only known new nuclear bomb currently under development.

title: Russia’s Prized Kerch Bridge Struck In Ukrainian Drone Onslaught (Updated)
summary: Ukraine launched a drone attack on Russia's strategic Kerch Bridge, resulting in damage to an arch over one of its road spans. This critical crossing connects occupied Crimea to Russia.

title: First F-15EXs Arrive At Kadena Air Base In Japan, 25 Now Delivered To The USAF
summary: The first combat-coded F-15EX Eagle II fighter jets have arrived at Kadena Air Base in Japan. This marks the first permanent deployment of the USAF's newest fighter outside the United States, with 25 units now delivered to the Air Force.

title: Italy unveils plans to develop a new naval missile launcher
summary: Italy has announced plans to develop a new naval missile launcher as part of its 2026-2028 defense programming document. The new system is designed to fire the Stratus LO, a land-strike cruise missile currently under development by MBDA for French, British, and Italian militaries.

title: U.S. Army Now Wants Concrete Bunkers For Troops In Israel, Saudi Arabia And Lebanon
summary: The U.S. Army is seeking to replace existing modified shipping containers with concrete bunkers for troops stationed in Israel, Saudi Arabia, and Lebanon. This initiative reflects a renewed focus on hardening personnel shelters in the Middle East.

title: Serena Williams winds down her VC firm, launches new fund, seeks $200M
summary: Serena Williams and longtime business partner Beth Ferreira announced Monday the launch of an early-stage firm called Starfire Ventures.

summary: Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.

summary: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

title: Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
summary: Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.

title: German Lawmakers Back Customs Powers to Seize Crypto of 'Unclear Origin'
summary: A new law lets Germany's customs agency freeze assets worth more than €100,000 without a criminal case if their origin is in doubt.

summary: The Ethereum co-founder says proof aggregation could deliver a "cryptographic proof singularity" much sooner than developers expected.
